The initial coherence lies in the physical interval 0 <= phi0 <= Phi_max.
The destiny equation is dot Phi = sigma * gamma * Phi * (Phi_max - Phi), whose fixed points satisfy sigma * gamma * L * (Phi_max - L) = 0.
By A12.1, each trajectory has an asymptotic limit L, and this limit is a stable fixed point of the destiny equation, so its derivative satisfies sigma * gamma * (Phi_max - 2L) < 0.
The encoding faithfully represents the intended domain; any formal-to-world identification needs an independently warranted bridge.
